description: Open the full dossier for one validated gap: the source complaints and their links, MVP scope, suggested pricing, competitors, risks, and a validation playbook. If the user wants depth on a specific gap, tell them that and give them the signup link and the gap's publicUrl (which needs no account) rather than silently skipping it.
